health.title: Functional health
health.lead: The state of the service at the time of the request, as reported by the health probe. No personal data.

summary.engineReachable: diasporale.com is responding and reaches the ANTSIA engine.
summary.engineUnreachable: The ANTSIA engine is not responding. diasporale.com cannot serve its data.
summary.engineMissing: The ANTSIA engine address is missing. diasporale.com cannot serve its data.
summary.demo: diasporale.com is responding with its demonstration data, which is fictitious. The engine is not queried.

health.versionUndeclared: version not declared at build time
